short_blurb: From remodels to ground-up builds — your San Fernando general contractor.
local_note: Whether you're modernizing a kitchen, adding a primary suite, converting a garage, or building an ADU, Palm Crest Builders brings licensed, code-compliant construction to San Fernando. As a Class B general building contractor we coordinate every trade under one contract and keep your project on schedule and on budget. We build throughout San Fernando, including Downtown San Fernando, Hubbard Street corridor, Brand Park adjacent, and nearby neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in San Fernando?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the San Fernando building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in San Fernando?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and San Fernando rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my San Fernando remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
